name: mobile-phone-store-ecommerce
description: Full-stack E-Commerce website for Mobile Phone Store university project

scripts.deploy: npm --prefix frontend run build && powershell -Command "Push-Location frontend/dist; Copy-Item index.html 404.html -Force; New-Item -ItemType File -Path .nojekyll -Force; git init; git config user.name 'Student Developer'; git config user.email 'student@university.edu'; git checkout -b gh-pages; git add -A; git commit -m 'Deploy to GitHub Pages'; git remote add origin https://github.com/thy-id007/mobile-phone-store-ecommerce.git; git push origin gh-pages --force; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .git; Pop-Location"

author: University Full-Stack Capstone Team
